title: Integral geometric fibre sections
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring and F a sheaf of Lambda-modules on X_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let f:X -> Y be integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], s:Spec Omega -> Y a geometric point with Omega algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], and (g',f',f,s) any Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. There exists an invertible module map Theta from the stalk (f_*F)_s to sections of g'^*F on X'. For every pointed etale neighbourhood (V,v) of s and every section z of F on V times_Y X, Theta sends the germ of z to its inverse-image unit under g', restricted along the unique iterated pullback lift whose projections are (f' followed by v,g') and the identity of X'. This restriction is defined independently of the exchange map.

proof.text: Use integral affineness and the direct-image stalk comparison over the strict henselization Spec A to obtain sections on an integral A-algebra Spec B. The comparison is characterized on neighbourhood germs by the unit and restriction formula.
The integral henselian-pair theorem makes (B,mB) henselian. Apply the degree-zero comparison to the proper identity morphism of Spec B, giving restriction to Spec(B/mB).

The separably closed residue field of A embeds in Omega. The fibre is obtained by extending Spec(B/mB) along this embedding. Field-extension invariance of sections gives a bijection. Compose with the stalk comparison; the maps respect module operations and the composition-of-unit equations identify their restriction on every germ with the specified lift.

theorem integralGeometricFibreSections
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f s) [IsIntegralHom f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ Θ : (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F) ⟶
        ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X'))),
      IsIso Θ ∧ ∀ (V : Y.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj V)
        (z : F.obj.obj (op (f.Etale.obj V))),
        Θ.hom ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber V v
          ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj z) =
        (geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq.toCommSq F V v).hom z
